scope: Two authorized Standard access/cost probes only; not approved game audio and not integrated into Unity.
planAtStart: Standard (user report; paid access and625 included credits confirmed by whoami)

tests.name: Exploration music test01
tests.prompt: Restrained electroacoustic dark ambient for a top-down survival horror game, instrumental, no vocals. Oppressive darkness and uncertain empty space, intimate and understated rather than epic. Slowly shifting low-mid drones, fragile bowed-string harmonics, a few muted resonant metal tones, sparse unresolved two-note motif with long gaps. No steady drum beat; only a very faint occasional pulse. Start quietly, let texture gradually emerge, then recede without a dramatic ending. Leave generous silence and spectral space for real creature footsteps and weapon sounds in the game. No screams, monster sounds, footsteps, gunshots, loud risers, jump scares, dance rhythm, or heroic melody. A music-only background bed with subtle internal movement.

tests.name: Bone limb concrete scrape test01
tests.prompt: Six hard bone-tipped limbs of a low fleshy alien creep across a matte concrete floor. Close dry irregular tick-scrape contacts in a quick alternating gait, restrained dull clicks and fine gritty scraping between steps, with tiny pauses. Isolated dry foley. No music, voices, breathing, insect buzz, exaggerated metallic ringing or reverb.

review: Both audio tasks succeeded and returned MP3 artifacts. Artistic quality, seamless looping and game mix still require listening/user review. No Unity integration.

budgetEstimate.assumptions: Estimates only, no quality guarantee. Excludes video/images, additional SFX and extra iterations beyond this sample allocation.
